edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC4 Business rules BR1 to BR10 are each proved
    Given the rule table of section 8 is the rule set of this story
    When the component and contract suites run against the fakes
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 has a test in section 16 or a guardrail check in the build, and a rule without one fails the build

  Scenario: AC5 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a provided operation is called with a request that is not authenticated, not authorised or names an unknown deviation
    When the caller is refused
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 as its cause dictates, and no deviation row, event or decision record is written

  Scenario: AC6 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write carrying an Idempotency-Key has been answered once
    When the same write is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the deviation row is written once, one event is published once and the caller receives the same record

  Scenario: AC7 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event
    Given a consumed event has been processed once
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the second delivery changes nothing and publishes nothing

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the skip trace activity has been dispatched for an open X6
    When the activity is retried or times out
    Then no trace is re-run for an answer already in hand and the case stays in DEV_WITH_OWNER until an answer arrives

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed status change is refused
    Given a deviation is in a state with no rule for the requested change
    When a status change the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing changes and no event is published
